thread:
sam: Alert: warm-pool nodes in us-west-2 failed keystore handshakes after last-night firewall tighten. warm-pool 0/40 for ~35m.

anya: Can you grab the log snippet?

sam: Here: 
```
2026-03-26T03:14:10Z gpu-node-03 keystore: decrypt err=KMS_DECRYPT_DENIED code=403 attempt=1
2026-03-26T03:14:12Z gpu-node-03 http: POST https://audit-shipper.internal/v1/logs -> 403 Forbidden
```

security-bot: 403 indicates egress path not allowlisted. Firewall policy now deny-by-default; controlplane IPs were added but ephemeral NAT ENIs used by warm-pool were not.

anya: Impact: autoscaler shifted load to other regions; estimated extra cross-region egress ~$1.5k.

sam: Mitigation plan: run small lambda to detect current NAT ENIs for subnet and add narrow allow for kms + audit endpoints for 2h. No full rollback.

keystore-bot: apply-allowlist --subnet subnet-warm-usw2 --endpoints kms.us-west-2.internal,audit-shipper.internal --ttl 2h :white_check_mark:

anya: Canary: spinning 3 nodes now. Watch keystore.decrypt.success_rate and warm_pool.fill_time.

sam: Canary result: 3/3 joined, decrypt.latency median 140ms (was ~2s). Warm-pool back to normal.

anya: Next: open RFC to switch warm-pool egress to controlplane static ENI or our managed NAT (reduces fragile allowlist cases). Add firewall CI test for ENI churn. Also record temporary exception (approver, TTL) in audit logs for compliance.

sam: I'll draft the postmortem and file the RFC. Closing once RFC reviewed.
